lectures.topic: Comprehensive Numerical Problem Solving Workshop (Modules 1 to 4)
lectures.learning_objective: Master high-yield examination derivations and worked problems across all 4 modules.
lectures.board_work_or_numerical: Full worked solution to 4 complex Part B numerical problems
lectures.practical_demonstration: Live walkthrough of previous university exam questions
lectures.real_life_application: Real-world engineering problem solving
lectures.expected_outcome: Confidence in solving all Part B university numericals
lectures.homework_or_assignment: Complete comprehensive revision sheet

lectures.learning_objective: Evaluate exam readiness and deconstruct 60-mark KTU assessment scheme.
lectures.board_work_or_numerical: Mark allocation rubric analysis (Part A 24 marks, Part B 36 marks)
lectures.practical_demonstration: Model answer paper deconstruction
lectures.real_life_application: Professional technical communication
lectures.expected_outcome: Preparedness to achieve O grade in University examination
lectures.homework_or_assignment: Final review of personal notes
